title: Custom Furniture in Bratislava — Own Workshop | DUMSKAYA
description: Custom furniture in Bratislava: kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, entrance halls, home offices. Our own workshop, measurement, delivery, installation.
h1: Custom furniture in Bratislava — design and manufacturing

blocks.text: Custom furniture in Bratislava — design and manufacturing

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and manufactures custom cabinet furniture for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces in Bratislava. We have our own production facility right here in Bratislava, and our team handles measurement, delivery, and installation. More than 15 years of experience in making furniture to individual designs.

We see furniture as part of the interior’s architecture. Kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, entrance hall furniture, TV walls, and home offices are designed for the specific room — based on measurements and taking into account the utilities, appliances, and overall concept. If we are designing the interior, the furniture is built into the project from the very start.

blocks.title: Furniture in Bratislava
rows: any brand fitted; Miele appliances through our partner

items: Custom kitchens — straight, L-shaped, U-shaped, with an island, with built-in appliances. See the dedicated page: custom kitchens in Bratislava.
Built-in wardrobes up to the ceiling, with hinged or sliding doors and interiors organized around your belongings.
Walk-in closets — shelves, rails, drawers, pull-out elements, and lighting.
Entrance halls — cabinets, benches, shoe cabinets, mirrors, and wall panels.
Living room and bedroom furniture — TV walls, wall panels, beds, nightstands, dressers, and bookcases.
Home offices — desks, shelving, and storage systems for documents and equipment.
Bathroom furniture and children’s room furniture, decorative structures, and niches.

parts.html: Fronts — laminated chipboard, foil-wrapped or painted MDF, veneer, HPL, acrylic, glass. Countertops — laminate, compact laminate, engineered quartz, porcelain stoneware, acrylic stone, and natural stone. Hettich, Blum, and Häfele hardware: soft-close mechanisms, pull-out systems, lift-up mechanisms, cargo pull-outs, and organizers. Our modern equipment lets us make furniture with complex geometry, integrated lighting, and concealed mechanisms.
We tailor the configuration to your budget — from standard to premium. For every piece, we prepare a technical specification and the drawings it is made from.

blocks.text: How to order furniture in Bratislava

items: Inquiry. Send us a floor plan of the room, photos, and examples of furniture you like — or visit the studio.
Measurement and design. We visit the property and develop the construction design, 3D visualization, and material specification.
Quote. The exact price of the pieces, including delivery and installation — as one amount.
Production. The furniture is made at our production facility in Bratislava; we confirm the lead time with the quote.
Delivery and installation. We deliver, install, fit the appliances, and adjust the fronts.

items.q: How much does custom furniture cost?
items.a: It depends on the dimensions, materials, and hardware. We give a preliminary estimate based on a floor plan and photos, and the exact price after the measurement and design. The price includes delivery and installation in Bratislava.
The lead time depends on the size of the order, the materials, and the current production workload — we confirm it with the quote. It starts once the design is approved and the deposit is paid.

items.q: Can I order just one piece?
items.a: Yes — a wardrobe, a walk-in closet, a kitchen, or a TV wall. If you are planning to update the whole apartment, it is more cost-effective to order an interior design project and all the furniture at once — in a single style and with one measurement visit.

items.q: Why is custom furniture better than ready-made?
items.a: It is made to fit your walls, niches, and ceiling height exactly, with the interior layout you actually need. Every centimeter is put to use, and the furniture looks like part of the architecture rather than a standalone piece.

items.q: Do you make furniture for Vienna and other cities?
items.a: Yes. For Vienna — with delivery and installation by our own crew, delivery included in the price: custom furniture in Vienna. We also work throughout Slovakia, in Austria, and in Germany.
